title: Interfaces WWAN parity depth pass (IF-14)
acceptance_criteria: WWAN GUI exposes advanced IPv4/IPv6 behavior leaves from the VyOS guide instead of baseline-only controls.
WWAN GUI supports DHCPv4 reject/user-class and DHCPv6 core flags/duid through structured controls.
WWAN GUI supports DHCPv6 Prefix Delegation row CRUD with validation and deterministic command generation.
WWAN parser/model round-trips advanced fields without mis-parsing IPv6 special address keys as normal addresses.
Frontend validation gates pass (typecheck, lint no errors, build, runtime smoke, UI smoke).
assumptions: IF-14 remains partial after this slice because modem operational workflows are still not implemented.
Chunk-load UI smoke failures are runtime process drift and should be resolved by restarting vm-ui on this host.

tasks.notes: Extended WWAN config parser/model to include advanced IPv4/IPv6, DHCP extras, and DHCPv6 PD rows; fixed IPv6 special-key parsing.
Expanded WWAN form UI into grouped sections with advanced controls and DHCPv6 PD row CRUD editor.
Added deterministic client-side validation and operation-build error handling for advanced WWAN fields and PD rows.
Ran frontend gates; recovered smoke failure caused by stale chunks via vm-ui restart and rerun.
Continue IF-15 parity slices after WWAN depth commit.
